lines.zh: 我在峡壁上飞，翼展很宽。
lines.en: I fly along the canyon wall on wide wings.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁滑过去，风在响。
lines.en: I glide along the cliff and the wind sings.

lines.zh: 我飞得高，看得到整条峡谷。
lines.en: I fly high and see the whole canyon.
I thread between the crystal pillars.

lines.zh: 我振翅两下，就升了三格。
lines.en: Two beats lift me three blocks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往下降，落在石台上。
lines.en: I descend slowly onto a stone ledge.
The canyon air carries me.
I bank with the current.
I skim over a cluster of crystals.
I do not land. I am only looking.
I circle once around a crystal pillar.
I rise slowly and watch the canyon floor.
I rest on top of a crystal spire.

lines.zh: 我的身体瘦长，翼比身还长。
lines.en: I am slim, and my wings are longer than my body.
Crystal columns line both canyon walls.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看着下面的东西。
lines.en: I tilt my head at what moves below.

lines.zh: 风把我的翼吹得微微颤。
lines.en: The wind makes my wings tremble.

lines.zh: 我在等一只虫子飞上来。
lines.en: I am waiting for an insect to rise.

lines.zh: 这块台子上有我的影子。
lines.en: My shadow lies on this ledge.
I draw one foot in slowly.
There is an echo in the canyon, and it is mine.
I dip my head and study a crack in the stone.

lines.zh: 我抬高头，闻了一下空气。
lines.en: I raise my head and taste the air.

lines.zh: 我的一只爪子敲了敲石头。
lines.en: One of my claws taps the stone.
Wind brings grit with it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢换了落脚的位置。
lines.en: I shift my footing slowly.
You stand at the bottom of the canyon.
I am flying above you.
I am not here for you, step aside.
Hold still and I will move on.
Your hand is raised too high.
This canyon is mine.
Leaving is much faster than staying.

lines.zh: 萨西里特峡谷里，我们一大群。
lines.en: A whole swarm in Sacilite Canyon.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在看你的眼睛。
lines.en: My head is tilted because I am looking at your eyes.
If you strike, I answer.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在峡谷里反光。
lines.en: Your armor throws light around the canyon.

lines.zh: 我退一步，是给自己留条路。
lines.en: I keep a little distance. That is my way out.
A gash has opened in my wing.
I fly crooked a while before levelling.
I retreat to the canyon wall.
Blood drips from my wing.

lines.zh: 我的长翼被打得偏向一边。
lines.en: My long wing is knocked askew.
I drop behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀每扇一下都疼。
lines.en: Every wingbeat hurts.

lines.zh: 我还能飞，只是不那么快了。
lines.en: I can still fly, only slower.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来护住翼。
lines.en: I turn to shield my wing.
I will not fall like this.
Is that an insect?
I drop a little lower.

lines.zh: 你手心里那是只死虫子吗。
lines.en: Is that a dead bug in your palm?
I take it and let it go.
Insects taste different.
Let me see what is in your hand.

lines.zh: 我先试试那味道有没有毒。
lines.en: First I check whether that smell is poison.
Not an insect. I fly off.
I hover and hesitate.
Too familiar. I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖掠过你的耳朵。
lines.en: My wingtip grazes your ear.
I drift up half a block.
Stop swinging at the sky.
I hug the canyon wall to pass you.
My wing brushed the cliff.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，我连方向都没变。
lines.en: That did not even change my heading.
I moved aside. A little.
Jump and you still cannot reach.
I swept past behind the rock.
Your stick struck a crystal column.

lines.zh: 峡谷里还有几只，飞得更高。
lines.en: There are more of us here, flying higher.
They do not come near me.
Each of us holds a stretch of wall.

lines.zh: 有一次两只撞在了一起。
lines.en: Once two of them collided.

lines.zh: 它们盘旋了一阵，散开了。
lines.en: They circled a while and parted.
We need no nest.
The ledges are where we rest.

lines.zh: 谁飞得高，谁就先看见猎物。
lines.en: Whoever flies higher sees the prey first.

lines.zh: Sacilite 峡谷的风，托着我飞。
lines.en: Sacilite canyon wind carries my flight.

lines.zh: 峡谷够大，容得下我们几只。
lines.en: The canyon is large enough for us all.
I catch an insect and swallow it.
Something bright lies on the ledge.
I carry the shiny bit up onto the ledge.
It rolled off. I cannot be bothered.
Too heavy to carry.
I take it up and fly two blocks.
It fell and I did not stop.
None of this is of use to me.
I set it down on the ledge.
The wind will take it. Let it.
Something is walking down there.

lines.zh: 我压低了高度，峡谷的风正托着翅膀。
lines.en: I drop lower; the canyon wind holds my wings.
It has not looked up.
My shadow falls behind it.
I am in the cliff's shadow.

lines.zh: 我算着到它那里的距离。
lines.en: I judge the distance to it.

lines.zh: 我从上方的光里滑下来。
lines.en: I slide down out of the light above.

lines.zh: 我们一群飞，翅膀响成一片。
lines.en: We fly in a swarm, wings all beating.
I begin to slide downward.
I narrow my wings a little.
It takes two steps left.
That is all. Here I come.
I cross on the air current.
It is directly beneath me.
I track it along the wall.
It passes a stand of crystal columns.
My shadow slides over the stone.
It glances up at the sky.
I stop beating and glide.

lines.zh: 晶柱间的水汽，我先尝到。
lines.en: I taste the mist between the crystal pillars first.
I drop two more blocks.

lines.zh: 我从晶柱之间穿过去，翼展很宽。
lines.en: Wide wings carry me between the crystal pillars.
It has come out into the open.

lines.zh: 峡谷里一群十几只，飞得密。
lines.en: A dozen in the canyon, flying thick.
The wind is loud in my ears.
It heard and turned.
I drop along the canyon wall.

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在石头上很响。
lines.en: Its steps ring on the stone.
I draw my claws in.

lines.zh: 沙西里特峡谷，我成群飞。
lines.en: In Sacilite Canyon we fly in groups.
My jaws close on its shoulder.
It bucked and threw me off line.
I roll and come again.
My wingtip rakes across its face.
I slam it into a crystal column.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的腿，我往上拉。
lines.en: It grabs my leg and I haul upward.
My hind claws push off its chest.
I climb and circle once.
Blood stays on the stone.
It dropped to a knee and I came down.
I cover it with my wings.
I strike it with a wing.
My landing is loud.
I fly in through the canyon mouth.

lines.zh: 我落在一根晶柱的边上。
lines.en: I settle on the lip of a crystal pillar.
Both canyon walls glitter.

lines.zh: 我的翼一展，影子就铺开了。
lines.en: I spread my wings and my shadow widens.
The wind pours up from below.
I level myself out.

lines.zh: 这处峡谷有很好闻的石头味。
lines.en: This canyon smells of good stone.

lines.zh: 一群同类跟着我飞进峡谷。
lines.en: A flock of my kind follows me into the canyon.
There is a path below.

lines.zh: 我绕了半个圈，往深处飞。
lines.en: I bank half a turn and head inward.
My tail fin flicks once.

lines.zh: 谷里没有别的东西在飞。
lines.en: Nothing else is flying in this canyon.

lines.zh: 我振翅的声音在谷里回荡。
lines.en: My wingbeats echo in the canyon.
The path below is narrow.
I dip my head to read the wind.

lines.zh: 我飞了一段，还没有落地。
lines.en: I have flown a way and not landed.

lines.zh: 火烧到翼膜，我急速下坠。
lines.en: Fire caught my wing membrane and I dropped.

lines.zh: 我在半空失了速度，直落下去。
lines.en: I lost my lift and fell straight.
Water filled my throat and I thrashed.
The blast tumbled me in the air.
An arrow skimmed my wing bone.

lines.zh: 怪力撑开我的翼，我收不回来。
lines.en: Strange force spreads my wing and I cannot fold it.

lines.zh: 峡谷里没有虫，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No insects here and I grow light.
Lightning struck and my wing went numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有石头了，我在坠。
lines.en: The stone below is gone and I am falling.
